steps.title: Check buildables for the crate
steps.hints: Look for Crate or any other storage piece, such as a chest. Note the materials needed.

steps.title: Gather materials and build a crate at the home spot
steps.hints: Gather whatever the crate needs, probably wood, sticks or logs from nearby trees or resources. Build it beside Zezima's position, on flat ground near the start. Remember the spot as home.

steps.title: Find and mine ore nearby
steps.hints: Explore around home for ore deposits, such as copper or tin rocks. Gather with the pickaxe until the bag holds about 10 or more ore. If nothing is near, widen the search a little at a time and keep track of the way back.

steps.title: Return home and store the ore in the crate
steps.hints: Walk back to the crate and store all the ore. Use the crate's id from what's nearby.

events.explanation: The wiki says a Crate is buildable from Construction level 1 and holds 16 stacks. Its material cost isn't confirmed. First I read the buildables list for the real cost, then gather what's missing, build the crate, mine ore, and store it. Copper is the likely ore: the wiki says copper nodes are mainly in the Fractured Plains, which I haven't confirmed as this area.
